label: NZXT Player: Three
description: Prebuilt gaming tower on an NZXT N7 B650E board (Ryzen 7 9800X3D, RTX 50-series on current builds).
notes: 2.5GbE RJ45 (Realtek RTL8125) on the N7 B650E; the standard build ships without a Wi-Fi card, so wired is the only path. 2.5G link lets it stress a multi-gig access port without a PCIe NIC.
